evidence: The Sb2Te3 substrate results highly crystalline with sharp peaks belonging to its rhombohedral structure (3Rm). In our previous work, through X-ray measurements conducted in BBXRD geometry, we described the crystal structure of our Sb2Te3 granular thin films, evidencing their preferential out-of-plane orientation along the [00λ] direction.
